title: Justification AnD evaluation, in pOlymyalgia RhEumatica, of BARIcitinib versus placebo (JADORE-BARI study)
official: Justification AnD evaluation, in pOlymyalgia RhEumatica, of BARIcitinib versus placebo (JADORE-BARI study)
summary: Main objective: To demonstrate the ability of baricitinib 4 mg plus short GCs treatment in comparison to placebo plus short GCs treatment to obtain a disease activity [PMR-AS-CRP] lower or equal to 10 without oral GCs (prednisone or prednisolone) at week 24 in PMR patients.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. At least 50 years of age.
2. Fulfilling ACR/EULAR classification criteria for PMR newly diagnosed or treatment resistant.
3. No GCs or GCs <15 mg/day since at least 15 days prior to planned randomization.
4. PMR-AS-CRP >17.
5. Absence of other inflammatory arthropathy, connective tissue diseases or vasculitis.
6. Able to give informed consent.
7. French health insurance holder
Exclusion criteria:
1. Clinical evidence of giant cell arteritis.
2. History of malignant neoplasm within the last 5 years (or 3 years in case of cervical carcinoma, basal cell or squamous epithelial skin cancer resected with no evidence of recurrence or metastatic disease).
3. Current active uncontrolled infection.
4. Treatment by probenecid.
5. Alkaline phosphatase (ALP) ≥2 x ULN.
6. Current smoker if age >65 years.
7. Patient under court protection or protected adults
8. Total bilirubin level (TBL) ≥1.5 x ULN.
9. Neutropenia (absolute neutrophil count <1000 cells/uL) (<1.00 x 103/uL or <1.00 GI/L).
10. Lymphopenia (lymphocyte count <500 cells/uL) (<0.50 x 103/uL or <0.50 GI/L).
11. Detailed exclusion criteria related to prior or concomitant therapy, general safety and laboratory data are reported in the protocol.
12. Uncontrolled high blood pressure or cardiovascular disease.
13. High risk of VTE because of a history of VTE (DVT and/or PE) within 12 weeks prior to randomization or a history of recurrent (>1) VTE (counting co-occurring DVT+PE as 1 single event).
14. Clinical evidence of significant unstable or uncontrolled acute or chronic diseases not due to PMR
15. Planned major surgical procedure during the study or medical history, blood abnormalities or any clinical condition that compromises inclusion.
